Kept only on this phone, so you can check the popup. If an offer was read wrong, copy this and send it to Kept support.
Offer Check only reads the Uber Driver and Lyft Driver apps, only to find the fare, distance and time, and only on your phone. It never taps anything for you and never sends what it reads anywhere.
Uber and Lyft aren\'t part of Kept. Apps that read ride offers may be against their terms. You use Offer Check at your own risk.
Allow Kept to read ride offers

To rate ride offers, Kept Offer Check uses Android's Accessibility service to read the text on the Uber Driver and Lyft Driver screens while they're open: the fare, the pickup and trip distance, and the time.

Kept uses this only on your phone, to show the profit popup. It doesn't read other apps, doesn't tap or type anything for you, and doesn't send or share what it reads. The last offer is saved on this phone so you can check it.

You can turn this off at any time in Android's Accessibility settings.
Tap Kept Offer Check, then turn it on.

Kept Offer Check reads the fare, distance and time on Uber Driver and Lyft Driver ride offers, only on this phone, to show whether an offer is profitable after your car costs. It doesn\'t read other apps, doesn\'t tap or type anything, and doesn\'t send what it reads anywhere.
